subject: Hospitality
title: The Bathroom Revolution
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Bathroom Revolution.

hook.text: Hotel bathrooms used to be tiny afterthoughts. Now, many luxury hotels make the bathroom the room's centerpiece.

buildup.text: Rain showers, freestanding bathtubs, heated floors, and premium toiletries turned bathrooms into spa-like retreats.

discovery.text: Open-plan bathrooms—separated from the bedroom by glass—doubled perception of room size without adding square footage.

twist.text: Not everyone loves glass bathrooms. Privacy concerns and cultural differences mean designs must balance openness with comfort.

climax.text: The Bathroom Revolution matters because clearer reasoning leads to better judgments.

punchline.text: 40% of the budget, most-photographed space. The bathroom became the hero.

quiz.question: Why do open-plan bathrooms work in hotel rooms?
options: They double the perception of room size without adding square footage
